WITH matched AS (
  SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
),
deviations AS (
  SELECT ID, SEX, igm,
         igm - AVG(igm) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM matched
),
scored AS (
  SELECT ID, SEX, igm, deviation,
         deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess
  FROM deviations
)
SELECT ID, SEX, igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation,
       excess AS `excess above sex average deviation`
FROM scored
WHERE deviation > AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX)
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
